resources.string: Obsidian wants to send the reminders and pinned notes of the vault “%1$s” to Note Pin for Obsidian.
Notes pinned to the status bar from Obsidian
Reminders set on notes in Obsidian
Try to swipe this away. If it stays, notes pinned to the status bar will stay too.
Show each note as its own notification
Android bundles an app\'s notifications into one card once there are several. On: every pinned note and reminder keeps a card and color of its own.
Everything reminders need is set up.
No vault has connected yet. Obsidian on this phone connects the first time it sends reminders, and this app asks you to allow it.
Its reminders and pins disappear from this phone. Obsidian asks to connect again the next time it sends them.
Note Pin for Obsidian shows the reminders and pinned notes you set in Obsidian as notifications on this phone. A few settings make sure they arrive on time.
Needed to show reminders and notes pinned to the status bar.
Lets reminders go off at the exact minute instead of a few minutes late.
Battery use is unrestricted, so Android won\'t delay reminders.
Android can delay reminders from apps it restricts. %1$s
In App info → Battery usage, set Battery saver to No restrictions.
In App info → Battery, choose Unrestricted.
Set the app\'s battery use to Unrestricted.
Installed. In Obsidian, install the Note Pin plugin: it sends your reminders here.
Install Obsidian and its Note Pin plugin; they send your reminders here.
Pins that can\'t be swiped away
Done: notes pinned to the status bar can\'t be swiped away.
Android 14 and later let you swipe away notes pinned to the status bar. To stop that, run this command once from a computer with USB debugging turned on, or on the phone with Shizuku or LADB:
Check it: post a test notification, then try to swipe it away.
The test notification is showing, and Android marked it as not swipeable.
The test notification is showing, and Android lets you swipe it away.
Nothing else to set up: Android brings notes pinned to the status bar back by itself after the phone restarts or the app updates.
Notes pinned to the status bar come back by themselves after the phone restarts or this app updates.
Turn on Autostart for this app. Without it, notes pinned to the status bar don\'t come back by themselves after the phone restarts or this app updates, only when you open it. Reminders still go off.

One UI puts apps you haven\'t opened for a while to sleep, and a sleeping app\'s reminders and pins can stop. In Settings → Battery → Background usage limits, add Note Pin for Obsidian to Never auto sleeping apps (Never sleeping apps on older One UI). Then pins also come back after the phone restarts, including the automatic restarts Device care can schedule.
One UI 7 and later show at most 3 notification icons in the status bar, then a dot, so a pinned note may show only as a dot. Swipe down to see it.

To see every pinned note\'s icon in the status bar, go to Settings → Notifications → Advanced settings → Show notification icons, and choose All notifications. One UI 7 and later always show at most 3.

In One UI 7 and later, the Clear button also removes ongoing notifications, and with them notes pinned to the status bar, unless the command below stops them from being swiped away. If they\'re removed, opening this app brings them back.

In Settings → Battery → App launch, set Note Pin for Obsidian to manage manually, and turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background. Without them, reminders and pins can stop once the app has been closed for a while, or after the phone restarts.
In App info → Battery usage, turn on Allow background activity and, if it\'s there, Allow auto launch. Without them, reminders and pins can stop after the phone restarts.

In Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management, allow Note Pin for Obsidian. Also turn on Autostart for it in App info, or in i Manager → App manager → Autostart on older phones. Without them, reminders and pins can stop after the phone restarts.
